name: EPIC 205935967
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 8.4 solar radii and 0.80 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 2,954 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.80 solar masses and 8.4 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,885 K at its surface.
